title: Chef John's Perfect Prime Rib
description: Chef John’s perfect prime rib recipe uses a foolproof mathematical formula to yield a tender, rosy pink interior and a beautifully caramelized crust.

steps.text: Bring rib roast to room temperature, 2 to 6 hours. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees F (260 degrees C).
Mix butter, pepper, and herbes de Provence together in a small bowl until well combined. Spread mixture evenly over roast. Season generously with salt.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. If your roast is larger or smaller than 4 pounds, multiply the exact weight times 5 minutes and adjust cooking time accordingly.
Turn the oven off; do not open the door. Leave roast in the oven for 2 hours. The trapped oven heat will finish cooking the roast.

video.description: Welcome to our culinary journey where we unveil the secrets to creating a succulent prime rib that will impress even the most discerning palates. In this step-by-step video, we guide you through the art of preparing and cooking the perfect prime rib. Learn how to select the finest cut, season it with a tantalizing blend of herbs and spices, and master the cooking technique that ensures a tender and juicy result every time. Whether you're a novice or an experienced home chef, this prime rib recipe is bound to elevate your cooking game and leave your guests begging for seconds. Get ready to savor a true culinary masterpiece!
